request_fields: instruction (summarise the consumer health question) + CHQ (SUBJECT + MESSAGE)
notes: 1,000 consumer health questions (NLM) with expert one-line summaries; the release has no train/test split. Suites define their own test subsets (e.g., MedS-Bench redistributes a MeQSum test file on Hugging Face; not downloaded here because the own release is complete and public). Checked 2026-10-04; no LLMs or API keys used.

rendering.rule: Instruction-style via the CLUE suite template (zero-shot): CLUE system prompt, blank line, then the user turn wrapping the consumer health question (CHQ).
